name: Valerie Dupont
source:
She once was a spoiled little brat.

Her father gave her everything to compensate the fact that he was never at home. And when he did, he never showed love to her.

She always thought that money was a synonym of happiness and that money could solve anything in life. She saw giving and receiving gifts as the best way of making friends and showing how much people care for each other.
